reviewed_overrides.holder_basis: reviewed board typo: Ron/Rob Dibble and CHC/CHI; selected Rob Dibble roster establishes Chicago Thunderbears
reviewed_overrides.evidence: 1988 selected Rob Dibble on Chicago Thunderbears '88 (tid 1806946), owned by chargingryno; master player 3561. Preserve raw Ron Dibble and CHC>PHI notation.

reviewed_aliases.evidence: The preserved 1972 board separately lists NNY Trentonjoe and NYN N4ser. Its untraded #15 selection is NNY Trentonjoe Billy North. Official 1972 standings list Trentonjoe's New York Times, tid 1620716, on the former Cleveland Wahoos roster chain. NNY is therefore this dated NYT club, not the distinct NYN franchise.

reviewed_paths.posted_team_chain: GB from CIN, VIA NNY, CHI
reviewed_paths.basis: reviewed original position, dated NNY alias and confirmed contract chronology
reviewed_paths.evidence: Original #4 belongs to CIN. The final board lists CHI and NNY as intermediates. On March 13, 2022, Brooklyn/Chicago sends the CIN first to Cleveland/Trentonjoe (confirmed post 12252247). On March 16 Georgia sends its 1972 and 1973 firsts to Trentonjoe for his held 1972 first (12253571); the final #4 selecting club is Georgia. These sources establish CIN→CHI→NYT→Georgia, reversing the comma-separated intermediate list as required by those dated receipts. The original CIN→CHI transaction date itself has not been established here.

reviewed_paths.basis: reviewed original position, dated NNY alias and confirmed contract chronology
reviewed_paths.evidence: Georgia's 1972 first (#19 in the published original order) goes to Trentonjoe in confirmed post 12253571 on March 16, 2022. New York/Trentonjoe then sends the #19 and #25 selections to SoCal for Bob Boone in confirmed post 12255387 on March 19. The final board SOC from GB, VIA NNY refers to Georgia→NYT→SoCal; NNY is the dated Trentonjoe NYT club.

reviewed_paths.basis: final posted club trail retained; differing immediate contract preserved separately
reviewed_paths.evidence: The final 1976 board lists DET from HOU via PIT&CHI. Confirmed post 12419978 instead records Pittsburgh sending its held 1976 first (#13) directly to Detroit for Dale Murphy and Dave LaRoche, plus Sparky Lyle going to Detroit. Preserve that dated PIT→DET contract in the rights ledger and retain the final board's listed clubs separately. Neither a repeated transfer nor a precise order of every intermediate club is established by this combination.

limitations: An original-order table is accepted only when explicitly titled as the first-round order. Other positions use posted notation, not inferred score rank.
A conflicting posted chain does not imply an extra transfer from the order-table origin.
Unique slots and franchise counts are structural checks; they do not independently verify the source positions.
Final draft-board club trails are not counts of independently confirmed immediate transactions. Transfer dates and intermediate owners are not all established.
A contradictory dated contract is preserved separately from the final posted trail; no repeated transfer or chronology is guessed.
